idea-plugin.name: iCal Highlighter
idea-plugin.description:
Provides syntax highlighting and templates for iCalendar and vCard files. Features:
  • Syntax highlighting for iCal files
  • Distinct colors for properties, parameters, values, and BEGIN/END keywords
  • File templates and live templates for calendar and contact components
  • Color configuration for different iCal elements
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0 — BEGIN:ADVENTURE

Your calendar files have places to be. Now they can get dressed for the occasion.

  • Syntax highlighting for iCalendar and vCard files: properties, parameters, values, and BEGIN/END markers finally stop wearing the same outfit.
  • File templates and ten live templates for events, contacts, alarms, and more. Fewer keystrokes between you and your next meeting. Sorry about the meeting.
  • Configurable colors, because your calendar may be full, but your palette has room.
  • Optional HTTP Client integration brings matching live templates to text/calendar and text/vcard request bodies. Your contacts can now travel in style.

No meetings were shortened in the making of this plugin.
